hydantoin_review.verification: Printed page1376 was rendered and visually checked;171 is the printed value, not a text-parser substitution. Repeated pH observations are not independent equations.
limits: Chemical reference constants are source-derived estimates, not directly measured biochemical pH7 labels. Source speciation, activity bridge, uncertainty and measurement ancestry remain unowned.

The original abstract also reports equilibrium measurements for hydroxyphenylhydantoin; its compilation entries here contain enthalpies. This does not prove the primary paper has no equilibrium result.
The dihydrouracil equation is already training row323(public671)/325(author675) and its molecular pools have historical input witnesses.

A hydantoin-ring substructure occurs in training row470(public671)/472(author675). The two achiral hydantoin reaction participants have nearest known-pool similarities0.524 and0.619, so these provisional graphs cannot meet the declared below0.5 criterion.
The aryl graph hypotheses are structurally more distant but their stereochemical/state identity is unverified; no D/R assignment is inferred from enzyme specificity.

nitrile_review.primary_abstract_establishes: Six hydrolyses proceeded to completion; only lower bounds on apparent equilibrium constants were obtained. Calorimetric reaction enthalpies do not supply finite Gibbs labels.

metadata_discrepancy.disposition: Preserve the source metadata unchanged. Flag the disagreement; do not infer or silently overwrite a scored chemical structure.

nitrile_review.motif_witnesses: C#N substructure occurs in formation rows146(hydrogen cyanide) and209(thiocyanate) in both audited tables; a blanket unseen nitrile-motif claim is unsupported.

provenance_limits: Graph hypotheses and known-pool neighbours are screening evidence, not authenticated measured states. Unresolved training structures and bounded historical inventory prevent certified absence. No exact UMA pretraining exposure is established.
